UK IS NOW JAILING PEOPLE FOR SOCIAL MEDIA POSTS — AND GEORGE ORWELL WARNED US ABOUT THIS EXACTLY

In the UK, thousands of people have been arrested and charged for what they posted on social media — especially during the 2024 riots and unrest.

People are being jailed for tweets, Facebook posts, and online comments deemed “hate speech,” “incitement,” or “misinformation.” In many cases, it’s simply expressing strong opinions or sharing unapproved information.
This is happening in the same country that gave us George Orwell, who spent his life warning about state control over speech and thought.
Orwell’s most powerful line on this:
“If liberty means anything at all, it means the right to tell people what they do not want to hear.”
He wrote 1984 as a warning against exactly this kind of creeping authoritarianism — where the government decides what is “acceptable” to say and punishes people for wrongthink.

•  Fearmongering with models — Claims of “millions dying” come from projections and assumptions, not actual body counts. No one can name specific victims caused by the cuts.
